messages.content: 獲取人類HbA1c、正常血紅蛋白和大鼠血紅蛋白的蛋白質序列和它們的3D模型。

function.name: protein_info_get_sequence_and_3D
function.description: Retrive the sequence and 3D models of proteins. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

model_3d.description: Set true to get 3D model of the protein.

message.reasoning: The user wants to retrieve protein sequences and 3D models for human HbA1c, normal hemoglobin, and rat hemoglobin. They want the sequences and 3D models. We have a tool function to retrieve sequence and 3D models. We need to call the function with appropriate arguments. The function expects a protein_name string. For each protein, we need to call the function. The function returns any. We should call it for each protein. The user didn't specify whether they want all in one call or separate calls. The function signature only accepts one protein_name at a time. So we need to call it three times. We can do separate calls. The user wants "人類HbA1c、正常血紅蛋白和大鼠血紅蛋白". That means "human HbA1c, normal hemoglobin, and rat hemoglobin". We need to provide the sequences and 3D models. We can call the function for each. The function has default model_3d true. So we don't need to set it. We'll call for "Human HbA1c", "Normal Hemoglobin", "Rat Hemoglobin". But maybe the names should be more specific: "Human HbA1c" might be "Hemoglobin A1c" or "HbA1c". "Normal Hemoglobin" could be "Hemoglobin A". "Rat Hemoglobin" could be "Hemoglobin A". But we can just use the names as given. The function will return the data. We'll then present them. We'll call the function three times.
